decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch within the firm’s established dumper business that still had its own product page in 2024, it reflects enough investment and visible commitment that management is likely to continue it.

This articulated dumper fits the core construction equipment range and remained prominently marketed in 2024, so a growing German machinery firm would likely stay committed despite any normal early-market uncertainty.

Because this mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and was downgraded from its own page to only a website mention by 2024 without reported commercial success, management has less basis to justify continued commitment.

A multi-model telescopic loader line inside the established portfolio implies substantial development and public commitment, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
This close-to-core material-lift line is backed by explicit positive demand evidence in the form of a large order, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Although distant from the established offer, the mining loader was given its own page and showed strong quantified field use after seven months, which supports continued commitment rather than withdrawal.
